categories.main_business_segments: TerraSky operates two main business segments: the Solution Business and the Product Business. The Solution Business provides cloud consulting, integration, ERP implementation, and managed services, primarily centered on Salesforce, AWS, SAP, and Google Cloud. The Product Business develops and sells proprietary SaaS products such as SkyVisualEditor, mitoco X, and mitoco, focusing on cloud-based groupware, data integration, and workflow solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced cloud technologies, specializing in Salesforce integration, multi-cloud system development, and cloud-based ERP solutions. Its proprietary products enable no-code/low-code customization, drag-and-drop data integration, and seamless connectivity between various cloud platforms and on-premises systems. TerraSky also invests in R&D for quantum computing applications and AI-driven solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: TerraSky primarily serves enterprise customers across a wide range of industries, including large corporations in finance, insurance, automotive, and manufacturing, as well as mid-sized and small businesses. Its end markets are organizations seeking digital transformation through cloud adoption, system integration, and workflow automation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are in Japan, with a nationwide presence including major cities and regional satellite offices. It also has subsidiaries in the United States and Thailand, and conducts some product sales in North America and Asia, with a strategic focus on expanding in the Asian market.
categories.supply_chain_position: TerraSky operates as a downstream IT service provider and SaaS vendor, delivering end-to-end cloud consulting, integration, and proprietary software solutions directly to enterprise clients. It also acts as a value-added reseller for cloud licenses and provides managed services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining leadership in Salesforce-related services, expanding into AWS, Google Cloud, and SAP ecosystems, and developing new growth areas such as data utilization consulting, ERP, and quantum computing. The company emphasizes talent development, multi-cloud capabilities, and continuous investment in proprietary SaaS and AI/quantum technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through project-based system integration and consulting fees, recurring SaaS subscriptions, cloud license resales, managed services, and maintenance contracts. The Product Business relies heavily on subscription-based models for its cloud software offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include other Salesforce and cloud integration partners, as well as vendors offering similar SFA/CRM and ERP solutions. TerraSky is positioned as a leading Salesforce integrator in Japan, with top-tier certified engineers and a strong track record, but faces competition from both domestic and international IT service firms and SaaS providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, TerraSky reported consolidated sales of approximately 24.7 billion yen, with a 29.1% year-on-year growth and significant increases in operating and net profit. The company has over 1,400 employees and continues to show robust expansion in both its Solution and Product businesses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TerraSky differentiates itself through deep expertise in Salesforce and multi-cloud integration, a large pool of certified engineers, and a portfolio of proprietary SaaS products that enable rapid, user-friendly customization and integration. Its end-to-end support, industry-leading technical certifications, and ability to deliver complex, large-scale cloud projects underpin its value proposition to enterprise clients.
